description: Core Workflow Execution, Set Tracking Reliability, and Performance Analytics Optimization.

tasks: Audit Today Screen Composables specifically for excessive Local State vulnerabilities, moving any complex mutation logic strictly into the MainViewModel (State Hoisting).
Analyze the Active Workout Timer's background mechanics to guarantee zero-latency countdowns, independent of the Compose UI's Recomposition cycles.

Implement sophisticated Offline-First synchronization caching to allow weightlifters to log intense active sets continuously through gym dead-zones without lag, uploading implicitly upon reconnection.
Deconstruct the master exercises list rendering, implementing standard LazyColumn Pagination blocks for remarkably smooth frame-rates (60 FPS) when scrolling through hefty exercise arrays.
Supercharge the Exercise Search Bar algorithm; apply rigorous debouncing techniques to a Kotlin Flow state emitted right from the ViewModel to prevent keystroke input latency and ANRs.
Design polished navigation transition animations morphing fluidly into the specific Set Graph Detail Screen from standard LazyItems.

Identify heavyweight calculations (Total Volume summarization, massive temporal loops) currently bottlenecking the Composable, moving those executions firmly onto the ViewModel's asynchronous Dispatchers.Default threads.

Develop an algorithmic dynamic Y-Axis bounds calculator for SetGraphScreen to intelligently clamp ranges, accurately portraying macro-progressions without extreme graphical spikes masking micro-improvements.
Protect analytical mathematical aggregations using SavedStateHandle caches to maintain complex graph renderings flawlessly during spontaneous orientation pivots (Portrait -> Landscape).
